name: wpilog-analyzer
description: AI-powered FRC robot log analysis via MCP. Analyzes .wpilog telemetry from the roboRIO.

commands.title: Set The Blue Alliance API Key
Clear The Blue Alliance API Key

wpilog-mcp.javaPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `java` executable. Leave blank to auto-detect the WPILib JDK.

wpilog-mcp.wpiLibYear.markdownDescription: WPILib installation year (e.g., `2026`). Leave blank to auto-detect the latest installed year.

wpilog-mcp.logDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the directory containing `.wpilog` files. Leave blank to auto-detect.

wpilog-mcp.additionalLogDirectories.markdownDescription: More directories of `.wpilog` files, listed and searched along with **Log Directory** (for example an archive drive, or logs another team published). REV logs are matched to a wpilog only within the directory that holds it.

wpilog-mcp.teamNumber.markdownDescription: Your FRC team number for TBA match data lookups.

wpilog-mcp.tbaApiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated: settings are stored in plaintext. Use the **WPILog Analyzer: Set The Blue Alliance API Key** command, which keeps the key in VS Code's secret storage. A key entered here is moved there and cleared from settings.
wpilog-mcp.tbaApiKey.markdownDeprecationMessage: Stored in plaintext. Use the **WPILog Analyzer: Set The Blue Alliance API Key** command instead; a key entered here is moved into VS Code's secret storage and cleared.

enumDescriptions: In WPILib robot projects (folders with .wpilib/wpilib_preferences.json), and wherever .mcp.json already has a wpilog-analyzer entry.
Never. Claude Code then finds the server only if you register it yourself.
wpilog-mcp.writeMcpJson.markdownDescription: Where to add (and keep up to date) a `wpilog-analyzer` entry in the workspace folder's `.mcp.json`, the file Claude Code reads to find MCP servers. Other servers in the file are kept. The entry holds this computer's Java and JAR paths, so it is never written into a `.mcp.json` that git tracks, and the extension offers to add `.mcp.json` to `.gitignore` when git would pick it up. The TBA API key is never written into the entry.
